title: NFL Preseason 2026: Teams That Need August Reps Most
body:
The NFL preseason is set to kick off, marking a critical period for teams to fine-tune their rosters and make key decisions that will shape their fortunes in the upcoming season. For some franchises, the stakes are particularly high, with quarterback battles, roster overhauls, and position wars that will determine the trajectory of their campaigns. Eight teams, in particular, are under the spotlight, with the Miami Dolphins and Cleveland Browns being two of the most notable examples. These teams will be using the preseason to settle their depth charts, evaluate new talent, and make the tough cuts that will ultimately define their 2026 season.

One of the primary storylines to watch this preseason is the quarterback competition in Cleveland. The Browns have been one of the most active teams in the offseason, making significant moves to bolster their roster and address key weaknesses. However, the quarterback position remains a major question mark, with several contenders vying for the starting spot. The preseason will provide a crucial platform for these quarterbacks to showcase their skills, impress the coaching staff, and stake their claim to the top job. Similarly, the Dolphins are undergoing a significant transformation, with a revamped roster and a new coaching staff. The preseason will be essential in helping the team gel and develop a sense of cohesion, which will be vital in their pursuit of success.

The preseason is also an opportunity for teams to assess their rookie classes and evaluate the progress of their young players. For franchises like the Dolphins, who have invested heavily in the draft, the preseason will be a chance to see their new recruits in action and gauge their readiness for the NFL. This will be particularly important for teams that are rebuilding or retooling, as they look to integrate their young players into the lineup and develop a sense of continuity. Furthermore, the preseason will provide a chance for veteran players to shake off the rust and get back up to speed, which will be essential in helping their teams hit the ground running when the regular season begins.

In addition to the quarterback battles and roster overhauls, the preseason will also be crucial in helping teams develop their team chemistry and camaraderie. The NFL is a highly competitive league, and the preseason provides a unique opportunity for teams to build their esprit de corps and develop a sense of unity. This will be particularly important for teams that have undergone significant changes in the offseason, as they look to forge a new identity and create a sense of purpose. By using the preseason to develop their team culture and build their collective mindset, franchises can lay the foundations for a successful season and create a sense of momentum that will carry them through the ups and downs of the campaign.

As the preseason gets underway, all eyes will be on the teams that need these exhibition matchups the most. The Dolphins, Browns, and other franchises with high stakes will be under intense scrutiny, as they look to settle their rosters, evaluate their talent, and make the key decisions that will shape their seasons. With the NFL preseason providing a unique platform for teams to prepare, develop, and refine their lineups, these eight teams will be using every available opportunity to gain a competitive edge and set themselves up for success.

Looking ahead to the upcoming season, the NFL preseason is set to be a fascinating and pivotal period. With so much at stake for these eight teams, the next few weeks will be crucial in determining their fortunes and shaping the landscape of the league. As the teams take to the field, the drama, excitement, and intrigue of the NFL will be on full display, providing a captivating spectacle for fans and setting the stage for what promises to be a thrilling and unpredictable season. With the preseason providing the perfect platform for teams to prepare, develop, and refine their lineups, the stage is set for a captivating and dramatic season that will keep fans on the edge of their seats from start to finish.
